actors.name: Applicant
actors.private_context: The Applicant has submitted a permit application to the relevant authority and is awaiting a decision. They have no special influence or inside knowledge about the decision process.

actors.name: Permit Authority
actors.private_context: The Permit Authority is the organization responsible for reviewing and approving or denying permit applications. They have standard procedures and a backlog of applications. They have not yet made a decision on this application.

shared_context: A permit application has been submitted by the Applicant to the Permit Authority. The Permit Authority has a standard review process that may involve checks, consultations, and internal approvals. The deadline for a decision is the end of August 2026.

starting_events.description: The permit application is under review by the Permit Authority. No decision has been made yet.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Permit Authority has communicated an approval decision to the Applicant before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
